# Qt build SBOM

These SPDX documents describe the Qt 6.11.1 build used by this MintVPN candidate. The original build-root path has been replaced with `/redacted/build-root`, document namespaces have a `-redacted` suffix, and references to the modified qtbase document carry its new SHA-1. No package or license data was intentionally altered.

This build inventory does not establish which components are present in the final linked application. Other dependencies and their notices are documented separately.

The historical upstream CI SBOM in `3rdparty/qt-6.11.1-sbom` describes a separate build and must not be used as the inventory of this build.
